findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.apollographql.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: LintSchema, GetProposals, RunSchemaCheck, RunSubgraphCheck, GetVariantDetails, PublishProposalRevision, UpdateProposalStatus, GetLintResults, GetSubgraphSchema, GetProposal, PublishContract · Private data: LintSchema, DeleteApiKey, PublishReadme, GetSupergraphSchema, RenameApiKey, PublishProposalRevision, CreateApiKey, GetSubgraphSchema, GetApiKeys, GetGraphSchema, GetReadme, GetMyIdentity · Public sink: PublishPersistedQueries, PublishReadme, PublishGraphSchema, PublishProposalRevision, PublishSubgraph, PublishContract · Destructive: LintSchema, DeleteApiKey, PublishPersistedQueries, RunSchemaCheck, DeleteSubgraph, RunSubgraphCheck, PublishGraphSchema, DeleteGraph, PublishSubgraph, GetCheckResults, UntagGraphArtifact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: LintSchema, GetProposals, RunSchemaCheck, RunSubgraphCheck, GetVariantDetails, PublishProposalRevision, UpdateProposalStatus, GetLintResults, GetSubgraphSchema, GetProposal, PublishContract · Private data: LintSchema, DeleteApiKey, PublishReadme, GetSupergraphSchema, RenameApiKey, PublishProposalRevision, CreateApiKey, GetSubgraphSchema, GetApiKeys, GetGraphSchema, GetReadme, GetMyIdentity · Public sink: PublishPersistedQueries, PublishReadme, PublishGraphSchema, PublishProposalRevision, PublishSubgraph, PublishContract · Destructive: LintSchema, DeleteApiKey, PublishPersistedQueries, RunSchemaCheck, DeleteSubgraph, RunSubgraphCheck, PublishGraphSchema, DeleteGraph, PublishSubgraph, GetCheckResults, UntagGraphArtifact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
